title: Blind-Spot Check: Motorcycle Beside You
intro: You want the right lane. Watch the motorcycle approaching from behind.
watchCaption: The motorcycle is in the amber car’s right-side blind spot.
safeCaption: Shoulder check reveals the rider. Hold your lane.
unsafeCaption: The lane change would crowd the motorcycle.
safeFeedback: Your shoulder check finds the motorcycle. You hold your lane while the rider passes.

feedback.mirror-only: The mirror missed the motorcycle beside you. Check over your shoulder before changing lanes.
feedback.drift-right: Moving gradually still crosses the rider’s lane. A shoulder check would reveal the motorcycle.
